question: In a 140 m race, Pankaj runs at a speed of (5)/(2)m/s. He gives a start of 20 m to Arun and still defeats him by 4 seconds. The speed of Arun is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Pankaj time** = 140 ÷ 2.5 = 56 seconds.

**Arun distance** = 140 − 20 = 120 m (given 20 m start).

**Arun time** = 56 + 4 = 60 seconds (since he lost by 4 sec).

**Arun speed** = 120 ÷ 60 = 2 m/s.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Total Race Distance** = 140 m, **Pankaj speed** = 5/2 m/s = 2.5 m/s, **Start given to Arun** = 20 m, **Beating time** = 4 seconds.

**Formula:** Time = Distance ÷ Speed | Speed = Distance ÷ Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/affc2cd2e08cbc2531794486ad40c59b2a316932ec7c04eaccf21f642148dd11.png] 

⇒ **Time taken by Pankaj** = 140 ÷ (5/2) = (140 × 2) ÷ 5 = 280 ÷ 5 = 56 seconds.

⇒ **Time taken by Arun** = Time of Pankaj + Time defeat = 56 + 4 = 60 seconds.

⇒ **Distance covered by Arun** = Total Race − Start given = 140 − 20 = 120 m.

⇒ **Speed of Arun** = 120 ÷ 60 = 2 m/s.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Head Start (Distance)

If A gives B a start of x meters in a race of L meters, B only needs to cover (L − x) meters to reach the finish line.

Beating by Time

If A beats B by t seconds, it means B takes t seconds more than A to complete his designated distance.

Dead Heat

A race is called a dead heat if all contestants reach the finish line at exactly the same time.</p
